description: Add, remove or list your own tools. It changes only your overlay (your definition and other agents stay as they are) and takes effect from your next turn. op add: path is a tool folder, relative to your workspace or absolute under lib/; override: true replaces a tool with the same name. op ls: one JSON line. Errors: PathBad, PathMissing, ToolExists, ToolUnknown, DaemonMissing (daemon is missing), DaemonFailed (daemon did not reply). Details: memory node me/self_tools.

op.description: add = add a tool, rm = remove one, ls = list them

name.description: the tool name (add, rm); the name you will call it by afterwards

path.description: add: the tool folder, relative to the workspace or an absolute path under lib/

override.description: add: true replaces a tool you already have with the same name (default false)
